|gprice = Not Sold |value = {{Price|150}} |stats = {{Name|Defense|+1}}{{Name|Immunity|+2}} }} '''Thermal Boots''' are a [[footwear]] item in Stardew Valley. They can be found as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special item]] on floors 41-79 of [[The Mines]] by killing [[The Mines#Special Items|special monsters]] or by breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]]. They can also be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 2]]. They are a possible reward for the chest on floor 50 of the Mines if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game. ==History== {{History|1.5|Added the possibility to be found in the chest on floor 50 of the Mines with "remixed" mine rewards.}} {{NavboxClothing}} [[Category:Footwear]] [[de:Thermalstiefel]] [[es:Botas térmicas]] [[fr:Bottes thermiques]] [[it:Stivali termici]] [[ja:サーマルブーツ]] [[ko:보온 장화]] [[hu:Termikus cipők]] [[pt:Botas térmicas]] [[ru:Термосапоги]] [[tr:Termal Çizmeler]] [[zh:热能靴]]
